stock.description: Jiayuan Services Holdings Limited specializes in property management across the People's Republic of China. The company provides a comprehensive suite of services to a diverse clientele, including property owners, developers, residents, and tenants. Its core offerings cover essential property management functions, particularly during the pre-delivery stage, such as consultancy, cleaning, landscaping, and maintenance. Beyond these, Jiayuan Services enhances community living with various value-added provisions, including home-related support services, catering, and the sale of goods to customers. Established in 2004 and headquartered in Jiaxing, PRC, the company operates as a subsidiary of Jiayuan International Group Limited.
